units: Pose values are the engine pose `s` (R for oy/ox, radians for tilt/yaw/pitch/roll). Frame f is at f*1000/60 ms and the engine is updated once per frame with dt = 1/60.

harness.cat: momo unless the case says otherwise
harness.note: rest: engine built in the state, lookX/lookY set, computeTargets(T*1000, T) called. enters/emotes: engine idle, setState/emote called at frame 0, then updated once per frame.
